notes: The marginal *Or, he went out into the antechamber* was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).

*out of* is taken as the `מִן`'s whole rendering, headed on *out*, which is the division rule 24 records for that preposition; the competing reading would make *out* a particle of *drew* and leave the preposition a bare *of*.
The glosses of s026–s028 are distributed in reverse across the segments; the surface, lemma and morphology were read instead (rule 39), giving article, noun and directive `he`.
